desc: Task 0: Ideation — run-state machine DP (prev char, run length 1/2/≥3) with O(26n) cost table + greedy lex-min reconstruction; validated on examples mentally.
Task 1: Implement DP tables G1/G2/G3/F0 (array('i'), INF=1e9, right-to-left recurrences, base G3[n][*]=0, F0[n]=0).

Task 2: Implement greedy reconstruction with (prev, run, used) invariant; forced continue when run∈{1,2}; ascending c with used+|v−c|+G_newR[pos+1][c]==total; continue-run dominance when run==3 and c==prev.
Task 3: Verify: examples ("cdcd"→"cccc", "aca"→"aaa", "bc"→""), edge cases (n<3, "aaab", "aabb", "aaazzz", "cccaaa", "abc", all-same), brute-force cross-check logic for small n; no bugs found.
Task 4: Final code review (int32 overflow safety, array('i') portability, n=1/2 handling) and deliver final answer.
